search_brands.openWorld: Retrieval is restricted to up to 25 Brands matching an ID, display name or Brand Data Value within the authenticated Relewise access scope. It does not crawl the public web or fetch an arbitrary URL.

set_decompounding_rule_approved.readOnly: Overwrites isApproved on one existing Decompounding rule; this is a configuration write that can change which rules apply to subsequent searches.
set_decompounding_rule_approved.destructive: Replaces the existing Decompounding approval value and can remove approval. The rule definition and scope are preserved, but being able to set approval again does not make this overwrite additive. The plugin workflow requires an explicit request for the approval change and inspection of the current rule.
set_decompounding_rule_approved.openWorld: Targets one Decompounding rule in the selected authorized Relewise Dataset. It does not accept an arbitrary destination or publish the rule definition to an external service.

set_merchandising_rule_enabled.readOnly: Overwrites the enabled flag of one existing merchandising rule and can change how subsequent Search or Recommendation results are influenced.
set_merchandising_rule_enabled.destructive: Replaces the existing enabled state and can disable an active rule. It preserves the schedule and rule definition. Re-enabling does not undo results already served while the rule was disabled. The plugin workflow requires an explicit enabled-state change request and inspection of the current rule.
set_merchandising_rule_enabled.openWorld: Changes one rule inside the selected authorized Relewise Dataset. It does not publish content or send data to arbitrary external destinations.

set_merchandising_rule_schedule.readOnly: Replaces the complete activation schedule of one existing merchandising rule; it writes the start and end boundaries rather than previewing them.
set_merchandising_rule_schedule.destructive: Overwrites both existing schedule boundaries. Omitted, null or empty boundary values clear the corresponding bound rather than preserving it, which can extend or remove an activation window. The enabled flag and rule definition are preserved. The plugin workflow requires an explicit schedule change and inspection of the current schedule.
set_merchandising_rule_schedule.openWorld: Updates the selected merchandising rule in the authorized Relewise Dataset. Schedule boundaries are stored there; no arbitrary URL, recipient or external publishing destination is accepted.

set_redirect_rule_approved.destructive: Replaces the existing Redirect approval value and can remove approval. The rule definition and scope are preserved, but being able to set approval again does not make this overwrite additive. The plugin workflow requires an explicit request for the approval change and inspection of the current rule.
set_redirect_rule_approved.openWorld: Changes approval of an existing Redirect rule in the selected authorized Dataset. It does not visit or fetch the destination URL stored in the rule, and does not accept arbitrary external destinations for this operation.

update_advertiser.readOnly: Changes the lifecycle state of an existing Retail Media advertiser to Active or Inactive. An omitted or null state preserves it, but supplied state values write live configuration.
update_advertiser.destructive: Overwrites the advertiser lifecycle state and can deactivate an advertiser. Promotion restrictions and locations are preserved, and archived advertisers cannot be changed. The plugin workflow requires an explicit state change request and inspection of the advertiser before the update.
update_advertiser.openWorld: Updates one existing advertiser in the selected authorized Relewise Dataset. It does not create an advertiser, contact that advertiser or send content to arbitrary external recipients.

update_campaign.readOnly: Changes approval state, schedule or CPM budget on an existing Retail Media campaign. Approving can permit serving subject to schedule, budget and eligibility; setting Proposed can stop serving.
update_campaign.destructive: Overwrites supplied campaign settings. A supplied schedule replaces both boundaries and clears omitted or null inner bounds. A supplied budget replaces CPM and the spending cap; a null or omitted maximumTotalCost removes the cap. Omitted or null outer fields preserve their settings. Targeting and promotions are preserved, and archived campaigns cannot be changed. The plugin workflow requires an explicit request for the exact changes and inspection of the current campaign; the tool is not a dry run.
update_campaign.openWorld: Updates configuration for one existing campaign in the selected authorized Relewise Dataset. It does not create campaigns, upload or publish creatives, or accept an arbitrary external destination. Campaign approval affects serving within the Dataset's existing Retail Media configuration.
